title: PBA: Yeng Guiao signs new contract extension with Rain or Shine

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Coach Yeng Guiao signed a contract extension to remain with Rain or Shine until 2030, the PBA team announced on Thursday. The Elasto Painters posted a photo of the veteran mentor being flanked by team executives led by co-owners Raymund Yu and Terry Que. His new deal, however, won’t take effect until 2028 as he is still in the third year of his current five-year pact. Rain or Shine is hoping to see Guiao steer the franchise to its first title since the 2016 PBA Commissioner’s Cup. “The journey continues.
